site.name: GorkhaPay
site.tagline: Compare the cheapest ways to send money between Australia and Nepal
site.description: Free, independent guide to sending money from Australia to Nepal and Nepal to Australia. Compare fees, exchange rates and speed for Wise, Remitly, IME, Prabhu, City Express and Western Union.

rate.note: Mid-market rate. Providers add a margin on top, shown in the table as an estimate.

providers.name: Wise
providers.fee_text: Fee shown upfront, roughly 1 to 2% of the amount. Uses the mid-market rate.
providers.best_for: Larger bank transfers where you want the real exchange rate
providers.licensed: AUSTRAC registered, ASIC regulated in Australia

providers.name: Remitly
providers.fee_text: Often no fee on first or larger transfers. Earns on the exchange rate. Express costs more.
providers.speed: Express in minutes, Economy in 1 to 3 days
providers.best_for: Fast delivery and new-customer promo rates

providers.name: IME
providers.fee_text: Low flat fee, often promotions for Nepal. Check the rate on the day.
providers.best_for: Cash pickup anywhere in Nepal, including remote districts
providers.licensed: Nepali company with NRB licence; check its Australian partner is AUSTRAC registered

providers.name: Prabhu Money Transfer
providers.fee_text: Low flat fee. Rates vary by agent and day.
providers.best_for: Cash pickup through a large Nepal agent network
providers.licensed: Nepali company with NRB licence; check its Australian partner is AUSTRAC registered

providers.name: City Express
providers.fee_text: Has run zero-fee offers. Check the exchange rate, which is where the cost sits.
providers.licensed: Nepali company with NRB licence; check its Australian partner is AUSTRAC registered

providers.name: Western Union
providers.fee_text: Fee depends on amount and how you pay. Rate margin is usually higher than online-only services.
providers.speed: Cash in minutes, bank in 1 to 3 days
providers.best_for: Paying in person with cash at an agent in Australia

providers.name: Your Nepali bank (SWIFT transfer)
providers.fee_text: Bank commission plus SWIFT charges, often NPR 1,500 to 3,000 and up. Ask your bank for the full cost.
providers.best_for: Approved purposes such as tuition fees, living costs for students, medical bills
providers.licensed: Commercial banks licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank

providers.name: Wise AUD account (to receive)
providers.fee_text: Free to hold AUD details. Your Nepali bank still charges its SWIFT fees to send.
providers.speed: Arrives when the SWIFT transfer lands
providers.best_for: Receiving in Australia if you don't have an Australian bank account yet
providers.licensed: AUSTRAC registered, ASIC regulated in Australia
